subject: Medford High School Fine Arts Program
overview: The Medford High School Fine Arts Department presented an informational orientation video detailing its course offerings, faculty, and student studio experiences. Department coordinator Mrs. Fee and several students highlighted electives including ceramics, design, drawing and painting, sculpture, AP art, and photography.

items.title: Department Introduction and Faculty Overview
items.summary: Mrs. Fee introduced the Fine Arts Department and presented faculty members Mr. Smith, Ms. Van Aken, and Mr. Cain.

items.title: Ceramics Courses and Club
items.summary: Stella shared her experience in ceramics, and Mrs. Fee detailed the progression from hand building in Ceramics 1 to advanced wheel throwing in upper-level courses.

items.title: Design Class
items.summary: Pedro discussed his experience in design class, and Mrs. Fee outlined project units that combine traditional media with digital tools like Canva.

items.title: Drawing and Painting
items.summary: Riz Shrestha highlighted course flexibility, while Mrs. Fee described foundational 2D techniques, media explorations, and peer critiques.

items.title: Sculpture
items.summary: Ruth described her work in sculpture, and Mrs. Fee explained how the course explores three-dimensional form using mixed media like paper-mâché and altered books.

items.title: Art and Ideas
items.summary: Kaylee and Mrs. Fee described how the Art and Ideas course blends studio art, art history, photography, and creative psychology.

items.title: AP Art and Photography
items.summary: Dakota and Mrs. Fee explained AP Drawing portfolio requirements and potential college credit, and Mrs. Fee announced a new photography elective.

items.title: Closing Remarks
items.summary: Mrs. Fee concluded the orientation video and invited students to reach out with questions ahead of elective registration.
